recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-I wants deterministic order for `then` group invocations, address it with a new explicit ordering decision that reconciles FHIR-20848, FHIR-20840, FHIR-25220, and FHIR-23010.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking whether a StructureMap mapping-language `then` clause can combine dependent group invocations with nested dependent rules, resolving to document invocations followed by at most one group of dependent rules and update the ANTLR grammar as possible.
initial_application: FHIR#20848 was applied with FHIR#20840 by commits 562bf9f82d7 and a81d5848a6, merged by PR #984 as b3a5ebd9c3. Those commits added narrative saying multiple groups may be comma-separated and the last group invocation may be followed by dependent rules, and adjusted images/mapping.g4 to permit invocations followed by nested rules. Commit db673c36e8 later refactored the grammar while preserving that dependentExpression shape.
additional_context: The mapping-language page is linked from current build navigation and links to mapping.g4; StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-20840 shares the same resolution and source application. Later FHIR-25220/FHIR-23010 evidence explains why deterministic execution-order wording from the old resolution should not be added now: FHIR-23010 keeps general rule order implementation-defined, and the FHIR-25220 R5 application thread explicitly dropped equivalent group-order prose.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already documents and parses the requested combination, and adding new sequential-order prose would reopen a later ordering question rather than safely complete this issue.

related_jiras.note: Same resolution and application commits for repeated comma-separated dependent group invocations.
Later mapping-language clarification revisited equivalent execution-order wording and intentionally omitted it during R5 application.
Current mapping-language guidance says rules may be applied in any order and order is implementation-defined.
